title: Scam!
body: You have to buy immediately and this app also tells you WHAT to do on a daily basis which is super creepy. Also you have to track every step you make detailed.. this App only wants your data - SHAME ON YOU!
author: Anne940

title: Actually good but too expensive!
body:
You even can not choose the language german… 
And you can not try it for one week free. You have to pay immediately!
If the app would be a little bit cheaper and it would be in german too I would buy it.

Man kann nicht einmal die Sprache Deutsch wählen. Und außerdem gibt es keine kostenlose Probewoche. Man muss sofort zahlen.
Wenn es etwas günstiger wäre und es die App in Deutsch gäbe, würde ich sie kaufen.
author: TaffyFluffyXYZ

title: No free trail to test out the features
body: You guys should really do a trail for a week or at least three days. I really wanted to try this app but im deleting it now because it straight up asks for a payment schedule with no free trail at all. I guess not a lot of people will pay 3€ to test it out for a week all apps have free trails at least for a week. Such a pitty.
author: G. Emine
